# Oscar Grows Across Ohio to Serve Nearly the Entire State for 2027 Open Enrollment


November 10, 2026 7:01am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_cf0e385e2d185942c72c9d928c46f52a/hioscar/news/2026-11-10_Oscar_Grows_Across_Ohio_to_Serve_Nearly_the_229.pdf)


COLUMBUS, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Oscar](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) , one of the fastest-growing insurers in the individual market and part of[Oscar Health](http://www.oscarhealth.com/) (NYSE: OSCR), today announced it is now available in nearly all of Ohio, bringing its affordable, tech-powered health plans to 73 of the state's 88 counties on the individual marketplace for 2027 Open Enrollment.


Oscar is entering 33 new Ohio counties, including the Akron, Canton, Toledo, and Youngstown areas, to bring easy-to-use healthcare to more Ohio individuals, families, and businesses. Close to 4 in 5 members recommend Oscar to family and friends because Oscar treats them like family and friends1 .


“Oscar is committed to Ohio and making quality healthcare more accessible across the state,” said Liz Drury, Ohio Market President for Oscar. “We’re proud to bring Oscar’s superior member experience to even more Ohioans through our tailored plans, giving them access to trusted local providers. We’re also expanding healthcare solutions available to Ohio businesses through CHOICE Arrangements, empowering employees to select coverage that works for them and their families.”


Serving Ohioans since 2018, this expansion gives more residents access to Oscar’s portfolio of health plans2 tailored to life stage, clinical, and work needs, including:


- [Oscar Bronze, Silver, and Gold Plans](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) *:* Coverage options designed for all budgets and health needs. Options include access to top-rated local doctors, $0 primary care and $0 virtual care3 with 24/7 availability, dedicated Oscar Care Guides, and low-cost prescriptions with instant home delivery.
- *Life stage focused plans* : Oscar expands its portfolio to support unique health needs across life stages. The new[RetireEase](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/retire-ease?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) plan eases the transition from early retirement to Medicare with set prices for key care services. This builds on[HelloMeno](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/hellomeno?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) , which provides a $0 package of menopause treatments, scans, and screenings.
- *Condition focused plans:* Tailored coverage for members living with[diabetes](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/diabetes-care?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) ,[COPD, asthma](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/asthma-copd?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) , and[cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/chronic-care-ckm?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) , delivering 15-25% savings4. Members can save up to $800 a year and get critical care for free. Think $0 primary, pulmonology, endocrinology, cardiology, and behavioral care; $0 labs; $0 pulmonary and cardiac rehab, pulmonary function tests, and oxygen; $0 diabetic eye and foot exams; $0 insulin and inhalers; $0 health coaching and medical devices.5
- [Dental and vision bundles](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/oscar-vision-dental?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) *:* Many Oscar medical plans automatically embed dental and vision coverage, with $0 preventive dental checkups, $0 eye exams, and discounted vision benefits6.
- [Oswell](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/meet-oswell?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-sc&utm_medium=south-carolina_all_null&utm_term=regional) *and[Oscar Unlocks](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/oscar-unlocks?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-sc&utm_medium=south-carolina_all_null&utm_term=regional) :* Every membership comes with *Oswell* 7, an everyday AI health guide that turns complex questions into personalized guidance and clarifies next steps. Members can also earn up to $125 in annual rewards points for healthy actions through[Oscar Unlocks](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/oscar-unlocks) 8. Members are eligible to receive an Oscar savings card to use points on premiums and receive up to 60% off at more than 70,000 retailers, gyms, and more.


**CHOICE empowers working Ohioans**


Workers whose employers offer a CHOICE Arrangement (formerly ICHRA) can use their monthly contribution to help pay for their individual coverage. CHOICE allows employers to offer competitive benefits with clear, predictable budgets. Employees are empowered with tax-free contributions to easily choose the best plan for them and trusted CHOICE administrators simplify the transition and implementation process.


Employers can enroll their teams at[hioscar.com/for-employers](https://www.hioscar.com/for-employers?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) , or through their broker.


Individuals, families, and employees can sign up for Oscar’s health plans starting Nov. 1, 2026, with coverage beginning on Jan. 1, 2027 by visiting[Healthcare.gov](http://healthcare.gov/) , calling 1-855-672-2788, or speaking with an insurance agent.


Oscar provides two provider network options in Ohio: one that includes Cleveland Clinic and one that does not. Anyone shopping for coverage should confirm that their preferred doctor and healthcare system are part of the plan network before enrolling for the upcoming year.


**About Oscar Insurance**


Oscar Insurance is one of the largest and fastest-growing health insurers dedicated to the individual market. Oscar serves millions of individuals across the country with innovative products and CHOICE Arrangement solutions (formerly ICHRA) tailored to their life stages, health needs, and budgets. Oscar technology-powered experiences make high-quality care easy to use and feel personal. Oscar is part of Oscar Health, Inc. (NYSE: OSCR). Learn more at[HiOscar.com](https://www.hioscar.com/?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-ohio&utm_medium=ohio_all_null&utm_term=regional) .
